description: ArcPath is a client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft that renders the flight path of throwable items when held by the player.

mods.name: ArcPath
mods.description: Shows a trajectory arc and target for throwable and projectile items.

releases.notes:
## ArcPath 1.0.0-beta-2

### New Features
- Calculated trajectory now accounts for player velocity
- Additional configurable arc styles (Dashed/Solid) per throwable
- Configurable arc gradient color
- Additional configurable landing marker shapes (Circle/Diamond/Square) per throwable
- Arc toggle keybind (default: Y) to show/hide all arcs without opening the config screen
- Toggleable debug overlay (default: U) showing previously calculated trajectories

### Known Issues
- Water physics are not yet simulated; the arc will not render through water or when player is submerged
- Trajectory is approximate and may vary from actual projectile behavior

releases.notes:
## Initial Beta Release

### Features
- Dashed trajectory arc for ender pearls, snowballs, eggs, tridents, and bows
- Landing target marker showing where the projectile will land
- Entity hit detection
- Per-throwable configuration via Mod Menu:
  - Arc color, line width, dash length, gap length, transparency
  - Target color, line width, radius, transparency
  - Enable/disable arc and target marker independently per throwable
- Trajectory caching; arc only recalculates when look angle or position changes meaningfully

### Known Issues
- Water physics are not yet simulated; the arc will not render through water or when player is submerged
- Trajectory is approximate and may vary from actual projectile behavior
